releaseNotes: Added the workflow scaffolder (layering plan phase E, requirement R8): npm run catalog:add-workflow inserts a typed workflow() seed into the chosen catalog/workflows file, validates id shape, domain, areas, and role against the real catalog vocabularies, refuses duplicate ids by name, bumps the count fixture that pins the catalog's totals, re-renders the generated projections, and then NAMES everything it deliberately did not do — the placeholder instructions to replace, the contract_empty failure a workflow with no outputs and no gates will earn, the five registration points a NEW gate script needs, and the knowledge:add front door for bindings. The fixture proves the insert, the count bump, the duplicate refusal, and the unknown-domain refusal against a synthetic skill root.

Committed the packs design (docs/plans/2026-08-20-001-packs-composition.md) without implementing it: additive-only composition under the unchanged validators, with ambiguous_write and unknown_dependency as the existing fail-closed composition safety, pack pins riding the same per-business re-pin as the catalog, and profiles selecting breadth over whatever packs supply. Implementation waits for a real second pack — capability without a caller is the exact failure the 2026-08-19 audit closed, and it does not get reintroduced by scaffolding a loader nothing loads.
